title: Signal: Package flagged for reinstallation
scope: A packages.config file that declares a `requireReinstallation` flag that marks drifted restore state.
limitations: It matches a `requireReinstallation` flag that marks drifted restore state in the parsed packages.config; it cannot tell whether the package is installed, whether any published version is affected by an advisory, or whether the dependency reaches production code.
fpNotes: A packages.config that mentions a `requireReinstallation` flag that marks drifted restore state in a comment, a documentation example or a template placeholder is not reported; the rule reads the parsed value that the installer acts on.
